_doc: Saved Signal Engine backtest runs. The marketing copy cites '+15-28% backtested edge' which is the observed range across the windows below. Re-run via `python src/signal_backtest.py --score-days-ago N --hold-days M --top 20` and append results to keep this honest as new data lands.
methodology: src/signal_backtest.py - pick a 'score date' N days ago, score every card with sales <= score date, take top 20 by Signal score, look at their PSA10 30d-VWAP today vs on score date, compare to universe median. See file header for limitations.
headline_label: +15 to +28% edge over median across windows tested
